name: Yanbu Cement Company

audit.method: Archived source PDF read from data/raw (SHA-256 recomputed and equal to data/raw/archive-index.json content_hash). Every printed primary-statement page (P&L, OCI, balance sheet, cash flow) rendered and read by eye line by line, both columns; values transcribed independently (tools/f_transcripts/3060.json) and compared with every published fact by tools/f_compare.py; composite facts re-added from their components; the born-digital text layer used as a second reader (tools/f_textlayer_check.py: 118/118 values found on the cited page). Notes 40 and 41 read for restatement and approval date; auditor's report read for its date. Offline; no data/**, AWS, Supabase touched.
audit.rejected_facts_note: No excluded/rejected-fact files exist in the repo for this symbol; a production rejected-fact registry (AWS DB) was out of bounds, so rejected facts are unverified.
audit.other_manifests_checked: Exactly one published manifest (data/imports/yanbu-cement-2025-fy.json). config/companies.json identity (name, sector Materials/Construction Materials) matches the document.

findings.evidence: The manifest notes, the reader tag 'scanned-primary-statements', the archive-index capture_method and docs/data/cement-sector-batch2.md all say the primary statements (printed pp4-8) are scanned images transcribed at 2.7x. In the archived PDF, pages 6-10 (the five statements) have a full born-digital text layer (PDF p6 text contains 'Revenue ... 1,083,964,180'); only the auditor's report (PDF pp3-5, printed 1-3) is scanned (empty text layer; the p5 render shows the BDO report signed 11 March 2026).
findings.fix: Correct notes/reader/capture_method: statements are digital text, the auditor's report is scanned. The text layer can then serve as an automatic cross-check.

findings.evidence: filed_at is the Board approval date (Note 41, PDF p46: 14 Ramadan 1447H / 3 March 2026). The unqualified audit report is dated 22 Ramadan 1447H / 11 March 2026 (PDF p5) and the Saudi Exchange file name carries 2026-03-11_16-20-46. The audited document therefore did not exist on 2026-03-03; filed_at drives fact ranking and as-of logic.
findings.fix: Derive filed_at from the URL publication timestamp or audit-report date and keep the board date in notes. Test tests/test_audit_batch2_f_3060_7202.py::test_filed_at_not_before_publication (strict xfail; remove the marker once fixed).
